usage.title: How to connect:
usage.description: Paste the following into Claude Desktop's config file:

shortcuts.ctrlShiftCHint: Copies content and pins it to the top of your list at the same time. Changes apply immediately. If the shortcut conflicts with another app, the previous working shortcut is restored automatically.
shortcuts.emphasisCopyHint: Hold Ctrl and press C twice quickly in the same app — the content gets pinned automatically so you can find it fast.
shortcuts.recordingHint: Waiting for your new shortcut... Press Esc to cancel.
shortcuts.recordNeedPrimary: Press a letter or number key to complete the combination.
shortcuts.recordNeedModifier: Shortcuts need at least one modifier key (Ctrl, Alt, Shift).
shortcuts.recordUnsupported: This key can't be used as a global shortcut — try a different one.
shortcuts.platformNotice: Note: macOS Command maps to Super. Some OS-reserved shortcuts can't be registered.
shortcuts.recordReserved: {{shortcut}} is reserved by the OS — try a different combination.
shortcuts.conflictError: "Copy & Pin" and "Show/Hide panel" can't use the same shortcut.
shortcuts.occupiedHint: Your previous shortcut is still active. Try another combination like Ctrl+Alt+X or Ctrl+Shift+V.
shortcuts.occupiedHintOne: Previous shortcuts are kept active. Suggested fallback on {{platform}}: {{shortcut}}.

lock.resetDesc: If you forgot your password, the only way to regain access is to erase all data and start fresh.

lock.statusDisabled: Disabled — anyone can open the app and see your clipboard
lock.oldPassword: Verify your identity with your current password
